consent.title: Informed Consent
consent.productPositionContent:
Lens is an AI-powered relationship pattern analysis and emotional support tool.

⚠️ This tool is not a medical device and does not provide psychological diagnosis, treatment, or prescription advice.
⚠️ If you are experiencing severe psychological distress, please seek help from a licensed counselor or psychiatrist.
consent.aiBoundariesContent:
· AI analysis is based on limited text input and cannot replace face-to-face professional assessment.
· AI may produce inaccurate or inappropriate responses; please use your own judgment.
· All suggestions are for reference only and do not constitute professional psychological counseling advice.
consent.privacyContent:
· Your conversation content is stored only on your local device and will not be uploaded to any server.
· You can delete all conversation records at any time.
· Anonymization ensures that real identity information in original chat records will not be leaked.
consent.usageCommitmentContent:
By continuing to use, you confirm that you:
✓ Understand the non-medical positioning of this tool
✓ Understand that AI analysis is for reference only and does not replace professional services
✓ Agree to call professional hotlines in case of emergency psychological crisis
✓ Are at least 18 years old (or have obtained guardian consent)
consent.userStatusContent: Since this platform adopts a fully local private deployment strategy, your continued use of advisor services on this device constitutes your reading, understanding, and acceptance of the Terms of Use and Informed Consent listed on this page. The platform will not send your consent record logs to the cloud.

setup.heading: Choose 3 Advisors for a Roundtable Discussion
setup.description: They will analyze independently, then read each other's perspectives, and finally the moderator will provide a comprehensive summary. We do not diagnose or decide for you—we only help you see yourself more clearly.
setup.questionLabel: Describe the situation you want to discuss
setup.questionPlaceholder: For example: After arguing with my partner, we've been in a cold war for three days. I don't know if I'm too sensitive or if they really don't care about me... The more detailed, the better (suggest ≥ 100 words).

setup.disclaimerExplore: For exploration reference only, not a diagnosis or treatment
setup.startDescription: Will enter 2 rounds of discussion (independent analysis → cross-response → comprehensive summary)
setup.bypassQualityHint: Not recommended, but allows the user to bypass the quality threshold and start the roundtable

setup.questionTooShort: Question is too short ({{length}} characters). Please add more background or click Still start on the left to bypass

guidance.suitable1: Complex relationship dilemmas (involving multiple people / multiple causes / recurring entanglements)
guidance.suitable2: Want to be 'seen' from multiple perspectives, rather than hearing only one voice
guidance.unsuitable2: Seeking quick advice ('What should I wear on a date tonight?')
guidance.unsuitable3: Only want a single professional perspective (e.g., just psychological counseling)

qualityHint.shortTitle: The question is short; the roundtable discussion may be superficial.

qualityHint.great: Sufficient information — the roundtable discussion will be more in-depth ✨
